## 💡 Feature Overview
A clear and concise description of what feature or enhancement you would like to see.

## 🎯 Problem Statement / Use Case
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? (e.g. *"I'm always frustrated when..."*)

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution / Behavior
Describe the desired solution or how you envision the UI/functionality working.

## 💻 Relevant ADB Commands / Technical Details
If you know the specific ADB shell commands, Android `settings put`, `pm` flags, or APIs involved, please share them below:
```bash
# Example ADB command:
# adb shell settings put global example_key 1
```

## ⌚ Target Devices / Compatibility
Which Wear OS watches or versions would benefit from this feature?

## 📌 Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or mockups about the feature request here.
